description.value: La Terrazza is a fine-dining Italian restaurant in Yaletown, Vancouver, operating since 1998 under Chef-owner Gennaro Iorio and partners. The kitchen pairs heirloom Italian recipes with seasonal BC-sourced seafood and produce, backed by an award-winning cellar of over 2,000 Italian wines curated by an in-house sommelier team. Private dining rooms accommodate weddings, corporate events, and anniversary dinners, and the restaurant also hosts curated wine-pairing evenings.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 13m; stands (5 spaces, covered) at 87m; stands at 87m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong contact and menu evidence. The website and OSM agree on address (1088 Cambie Street, V6B 6J5) and URL; the website adds a phone number (+1 604-899-4449) absent from OSM. Multiple vegetarian dishes appear on the menu and OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes, supporting that amenity. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, leaving all required criteria unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; +1 (604) 899-4449 sourced from website only — added to top-level phone field.
Contact subpage shows a possible postal code typo 'V6B 675' in one location; all other pages and OSM consistently show 'V6B 6J5'.
Restaurant enforces a dress code (website lists 'Dress Code & FAQ' nav item); cyclists in riding kit may not be admitted.

OSM opening_hours tag (Tu-Th 17:00-22:00, Sa-Su 17:00-23:00) does not match website (Tuesday–Saturday 5:00 pm–10:00 pm) — website indicates Friday is included and Sunday/Monday are closed; OSM omits Friday and lists different Saturday close time.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: La Terrazza is a confirmed operating business, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be verified from the website or OSM tags. Additionally, the restaurant enforces a dress code, which may deter touring cyclists arriving in cycling attire.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian dishes: Garden Arugula Apple Salad, Melanzane alla Parmigiana (baked Italian eggplant), Burrata & Beet Insalata, Burrata Caprese, and Insalata Caprese on the happy-hour menu

wow_evidence: award-winning cellar of over 2,000 Italian wines curated by an in-house sommelier team

price.label: Fine dining
price.signal: Fine-dining restaurant; award-winning wine cellar; sommelier; curated experiences
